## ⚠️ This card's fix shape is now **stale in its step 2**, and its mutant M1 is about to become shipped, declared behaviour — re-measured 2026-09-16

`domain:spec` execution seat, `session_01KB5PFtxuy1x3dcR5gxudx6`, 2026-09-16T16:2xZ. ⛔ No label change, ⛔ no re-grade, ⛔ not claimed. Recorded so whoever dispatches this card does not implement a step that no longer type-checks against the gate.

Surfaced by the isolated at-tier contract review of **PR #18486** (card #18123), record `5700807570`, which reached this card's subject on its own and escalated it as the FAIL driver.

### What moved under this card

PR #18486 (in flight, `draft`) executes #18115 option A: it **deletes `DURATION_SHAPED_TOKENS` and `isDurationShaped()` outright**, and re-seats the JSDoc-divergence branch on

```
keyUnits > 0 && jsdocUnits > 0 && !agree
                                  ^^^^^^ the agreement carve-out:
                                  && !site.jsdocUnits.some((u) => site.keyUnits.includes(u))
```

⇒ **step 2 of this card's suggested fix — 「widen the branch to `(site.durationShaped || site.keyUnits.length > 0)`」 — is no longer implementable as written**: `durationShaped` will not exist, and the `keyUnits.length > 0` half has effectively landed. What now stands between the gate and this card's ruled class is the **agreement carve-out**, not the guard this card named.

### ⭐ And the direction is worse than "stale"

This card measured mutant **M1** (「letting a unit in the *name* make the JSDoc satisfy the rule without a describe」) as a **back door that passes the whole self-test** — correct behaviour, unpinned guarantee.

Measured on PR #18486's head by the at-tier review, with fixtures through **both** `judge()` implementations:

```
timeoutMs       + JSDoc "in milliseconds" + describe 'Maximum execution time'
intervalSeconds + JSDoc "in seconds"      + no describe
        base: REFUSED  unit-in-jsdoc-not-in-describe
        head: passes
```

⇒ **M1's shape stops being a mutant and becomes the shipped predicate.** And it is unpinned in the other direction too: deleting the carve-out reds **0** self-test cases — the same vacuity this card reported, now guarding the opposite behaviour.

⚠️ The head's `judge()` comment currently **argues the carve-out is correct** (「Refusing there would manufacture offenders out of agreement … the measured proof」), which adjudicates this open card from inside another PR. The seat has returned that PR as **FAIL** partly on that ground: its remediation must restate the carve-out as **deferred to this card**, ⛔ not as settled, and must add two `expect()` cases pinning the two fixtures as `''` **labelled `DEFERRED to #18075`**, so the carve-out becomes deletable-and-detectable.

### ⇒ This card's fix shape, restated against the tree it will actually meet

In ruling A's own order (remediation before rule widening), unchanged in spirit:

1. **Unchanged** — a describe-only card for the two live rows (`latencyMs`, `frequencyHours`). No rename owed; the unit is already in each key name, only the published `.describe()` is silent.
2. **Replaced** — 「delete the agreement carve-out」 (`&& !site.jsdocUnits.some((u) => site.keyUnits.includes(u))`), ⛔ not 「widen to `durationShaped || keyUnits > 0`」, which will no longer parse.
3. **Sharpened** — the positive control this card asked for is the *same fixture*, and after #18486's remediation it will already exist in the self-test as a **DEFERRED** case expecting `''`. The successor's act is to **flip it from DEFERRED to POSITIVE** (expecting `unit-in-jsdoc-not-in-describe`), which is also what proves the deletion in step 2 bites.

⛔ **Order still matters**, and for the same reason: deleting the carve-out before the two describe-only remediations reds `latencyMs` and `frequencyHours` on `main` — the sequencing ruling A rejected as option B.

### ⛔ What this comment does not do

It does ⛔ not re-grade this card, ⛔ not claim it, and ⛔ not rule on whether agreement is an offence — that question is still this card's, and #18486's remediation is being required to say so in its own words rather than answer it. ⚠️ And ⛔ do not dispatch this card while PR #18486 is open: its predicate is the subject.

**Dedupe words for anyone searching this thread**: `agreement carve-out` · `unit-in-jsdoc-not-in-describe keyUnits` · `latencyMs frequencyHours describe-only` · `M1 back door`.

## Premise re-verification before dispatch — **the mechanism half of this card is overtaken; the symptom half is NOT measured**

`domain:spec` execution seat, 2026-09-16T23:17:45Z. ⛔ No grading and no label change — 「车道席可附证据/前提重验,⛔ 不定级不改标」. This is a reading, filed because the seat was about to dispatch this card and stopped.

**PR #18486 (card #18123) landed at 19:11Z today** — "check-duration-unit-keys admits by declaration — **retire the name-shape token list**". That is the very list this card's finding rests on.

### Measured on `origin/main` `582d3e54ea3d0db31c56b5c624cd3195ef5043ee`

| probe | result |
|---|---|
| `DURATION_SHAPED_TOKENS` in `packages/spec/scripts/check-duration-unit-keys.ts` | **exit 1 — gone** |
| `isDurationShaped` in the same file | **exit 1 — gone** |
| lit control, same file (`durationShaped\|jsdocUnits\|keyUnits`) | **20 lines** ⇒ the file is there and the probe can see it |
| the divergence rule's guard today, `:831` | `if (site.keyUnits.length > 0 && site.jsdocUnits.length > 0 …` |
| the census arm, `:483` | `\|\| site.keyUnits.length > 0` |

⇒ **The card's mechanism is dead as written.** It says the verdict is gated on `site.durationShaped` alone — a 25-token **name list** — while the census also admits via `keyUnits`. On today's tree there is no such predicate, and the divergence rule is now gated on **`keyUnits`**, which is precisely the arm the card said could never be judged.

### What is NOT measured, and is the whole remaining question

Both named rows still exist, unchanged:

- `packages/spec/src/ai/usage.zod.ts:52` — `latencyMs: z.number().nonnegative().optional(),` (still no `.describe()` at all)
- `packages/spec/src/system/tenant.zod.ts:603` — `frequencyHours: … .describe('Backup frequency')` (still names no unit)

⚠️ **Whether they are now judged and refused, the seat did NOT measure** — that needs the gate run, not a grep. ⛔ It is not being assumed in either direction: "the guard now names `keyUnits`" is a reading of source, not a verdict on those two rows.

### Why this was not dispatched

A round dispatched on this body would have spent its first act reporting `premise_still_valid: false`, which is exactly what happened on #17848 today. Better to put the measurement on the card first. For whoever picks it up or re-grades it, the live question is one command away: **run `check:duration-unit-keys` on today's `main` and read whether those two rows are refused.**

- If they **are** refused → the gap closed with #18486 and this card is spent; close it on the reading.
- If they are **not** → there is still a finding, but its mechanism must be re-derived against the `keyUnits`-gated rule, ⛔ not the retired token list, and the card body needs rewriting before it can be dispatched.

⚠️ One more coupling worth naming: **#18123's acceptance item (e) is in the decision box** and it rules on this same gate's admission channel (whether prose admits at all). If it goes the literal way, the census's `proseUnits` arm changes under whatever is written here. Serializing this card behind that ruling is the safer order.

⭐ Also worth preserving from the original filing: its methodology note. A first attempt measured set membership with a single-line `grep -o` against a `Set` literal spanning four lines and got `no` for **every** token — a broken-instrument zero caught only because `timeout` was carried as a **lit control** and is visibly in the set. That is the reason this lane requires a same-subject control on every zero.

> the unit must not already BE in the name — a JSDoc that says milliseconds over a key called `latencyMs` names no unit the key name does not already carry, and the published reference page prints that key name. ⛔ **This half is DEFERRED to #18075**, ⛔ not argued correct here: refusing the agreement shape today reds the two live rows on `main` (`latencyMs`, `frequencyHours`); **whether it is an offence is that card's question.** It also repeals a base refusal — shape (b) in this file's header — and the two self-test cases labelled `DEFERRED to #18075` pin it in both directions, so deleting this half of the guard goes red.

派发席若照卡面去「补漏判」,就是替维护者选了答案。⛔ 本席不选。

改挂 **`pm:retriage`**,按决策卡重写:主张 = 「同意形是否构成违规」,两个答案各自的落地形态、各自要动的钉子与会变红的行都已可点名(见上)。若维护者判「是」,它随即变回一张干净的实现卡,范围 = guard 第二半 + 两行 describe + 两个 self-test 钉子。
